name: pos-selfcheck-m3-hardening
title: Harden POS selfcheck-m3: hermetic sandbox cleanup on failure (F-017) + LOCK_DIR survival assertion in sub-check M (F-018)
description: Two LOW test-hardening follow-ups accepted as accepted_risk during B-f511's M3 review, confined to experiments/pos-instrument-replay/selfcheck-m3.mjs. F-017: fail() uses process.exit(1), which skips finally blocks, so a mkdtemp sandbox tmp dir leaks whenever a sub-check FAILS (the regression path), a pattern shared by all sub-checks A-M. F-018: sub-check M asserts exit 2 + diagnostic + break-mutex released + ledger untouched, but does not explicitly assert that LOCK_DIR/.batch-ledger.lock and holder.json survive the forced break failure (they do today, confirmed by inspection). Both are test-hygiene improvements, NOT correctness bugs.
